verdict.rationale: Vue's own site lists Vue Router as an official library alongside Pinia. Several independent developers name Vue's official router as a key advantage that removes the need to pick and track third-party routing libraries. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation in the pack describing Vue Router's features and how it integrates with components and reactivity (the doc evidence is only a navigation listing), and hands-on detail on how seamless the integration is beyond general praise.
